content:
maria: Heads up — after the 02:00 runtime rollout we saw +7–12% p99 on small-chat seq32 workloads on a subset of SM86 trays. Kernel selector is choosing the fp8-optimized FastMatMul path even when device reports no fp8 support. Dump attached.
aj: @maria which trays? logs?
maria: Sample from node-17:
```
[2025-11-03 02:17:11] device_probe: sm: 86, driver: 537.36, tensor_cores: true
[2025-11-03 02:17:11] hw_features: bf16: true, fp8: false
[2025-11-03 02:17:11] kernel_picker: picked path FastMatMul.fp8_fallback (heuristic_score=0.82)
```
Note: fp8 false but picker still picked fp8 path with fallback.
sam_w: perf-bot posted a microbench a minute later:
perf-bot: AUTOTUNE REPORT node-17:
cold_kv_latency: 1.8ms
warm_kv_latency: 0.6ms
seq32_throughput_cold: 420 tok/s
seq32_throughput_warm: 980 tok/s
picked_kernel: FastMatMul.fp8_fallback
alt_kernel: MatMul.bf16_fast
regression: +9% p99 vs baseline
devon: I think the picker uses the first microbench sample (cold_kv). If cold sample favors fp8 path due to lower latency on uncached KV but once warmed the bf16 path is better. Batching heuristics change throughput profile and the heuristic_score is computed from cold sample.
aj: Can repro locally with:
```
./tools/probe_device --warm-kv=false --seq=32 --batch=1
./runtime --autotune --target=node-17
```
Works for me: cold run -> fp8 pick, warm run -> bf16 pick.
maria: So autotune got locked in during bootstrapping (first-sample bias). We need to store both cold/warm profiles and prefer warm for steady-state or at least re-eval after X minutes. Also kernel choice should be validated with a small warmup microbench before locking.
devon: @aj @maria can someone file an infra PR to change autotune state machine? Proposal:
- record sample labels (cold/warm)
- require 2 samples with warm_kv_latency < threshold before accepting high-throughput path
- schedule a re-eval on first 1000 requests or 60s

I can draft tests.
aj: I'll open RFC and a quick fix: fallback to alt_kernel if observed p99 increases by >5% after 30s. Put it behind flag `--autotune-stabilize=true`.
sam_w: :thumbsup: also add a sentinel in logs so ops can see 'autotune: warm_confirmed' for metrics.
maria: Thanks. I also uploaded perf traces to s3: s3://redwood-inference/perf-traces/node17/4250000000.zip — contains perf, nvprof and tracer outputs.
devon: Nice. Follow-ups: (1) add explicit fp8 capability check in kernel_picker; (2) ensure probe uses driver API not heuristic env var; (3) add unit test that simulates KV cache warming transitions.
perf-bot: NOTES: created issue #6124 'autotune: prefer warm profile; avoid bootstrapping bias' and linked PR draft. cc @eng-runtime
